leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom error class that extends the built-in Error object
Implement a centralized error handling middleware function in Express.js
Configure the middleware to catch both operational and programming errors
Manipulate error responses to provide consistent structure across the API
Integrate the error handler as the last middleware in the Express application
Initialize error instances with appropriate HTTP status codes and messages
Apply the error handler to differentiate between development and production environments
